name: comment
script:
# Check if rejection reason exists in doc
rejection_reason = doc.get("rejection_reason") or doc.get("remarks")

if rejection_reason and doc.docstatus == 0:
    frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "Comment",
        "comment_type": "Comment",
        "reference_doctype": doc.doctype,
        "reference_name": doc.name,
        "content": f"Rejected: {rejection_reason}",
        "comment_by": frappe.session.user
    }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    # Clear to prevent duplicate on next save
    frappe.db.set_value(doc.doctype, doc.name, "remarks", "")
